title: Cyberwave Locomotion Velocity Command
description: Canonical body-frame velocity command consumed by backend, SDK, simulator, and edge locomotion adapters.

linear_x.description: Forward velocity in meters per second in the robot body frame.

linear_y.description: Lateral velocity in meters per second in the robot body frame. Adapters without lateral motion support must clamp or drop this to zero.

angular_z.description: Yaw velocity in radians per second.

duration_ms.description: Requested command hold duration. A value of 0 represents an immediate stop command.
